item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00149","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C10","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.83,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C25 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child's two-step machinery: establish or designate a federal body with assigned duties, then direct other departments and agencies to furnish assistance that body requests. The language and operative function of C25 paragraph 4 closely match child paragraph 2, beyond generic cooperation boilerplate. C10 and C23 are weaker parallels involving assignment or transfer of statutory functions to a designated agency, but they lack the child's closely matched requested-assistance provision.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Department of State, the Department of the Army, and such other agencies of the Government as the Displaced Persons Commission may request, shall ... furnish the Commission such assistance as it may need in carrying out its responsibilities","parent_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee in its work, and to furnish the Committee such information or the services of such persons as the Committee may require in the performance of its duties.","explanation":"Both provisions require federal departments and agencies to furnish a newly empowered body the assistance, information, or personnel it requests to perform its assigned duties."},{"child_excerpt":"the Displaced Persons Commission is hereby designated as the agency which shall ... make or prepare the investigations and written reports required by section 10","parent_excerpt":"There shall be created ... an advisory committee ... The Committee is authorized ... to examine into the rules, procedures and practices ... and shall make such recommendations","explanation":"Both orders first empower a named body to investigate or examine and report or recommend, then support that work through an interagency-cooperation clause."}]}
